title: The impact of PANoptosis-related genes on immune profiles and subtype classification in ischemic stroke.
authors: Cai, Xinrui; Ren, Yu; Wu, Haiyun; Tan, Yongjun; Zhou, Li; Wang, Yilin; Yang, Qinghuan; Wang, Jiani; Tang, Hao; Wen, Jun; Zhao, Yong; Wang, Ling; Xu, Xinlei; Huang, Jiagui; Yang, Qin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究缺血性卒中中PANoptosis相关基因的免疫特征与亚型分类，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ischemic stroke (IS) is an acute neurological disorder causing brain dysfunction, with high mortality and disability. PANoptosis is a synchronized sort of regulated cell demise that combines the characteristics of pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis. However, its role in ischemic stroke remains unclear. We downloaded the ischemic stroke-related microarray dataset GSE58294 from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database and identified Differentially expressed PANoptosis-related genes (DE-PRGs). We utilized three algorithms to identify diagnostic DE-PRGs, constructed a nomogram for diagnostic modeling, and evaluated their diagnostic performance with receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis. Additionally, we develop interaction networks linking genes with miRNAs, transcription factors, and drugs. We also analyzed gene expression in different cell subgroups using the GSE174574 single-cell dataset. We applied consensus clustering to classify stroke samples into subtypes and compared immune microenvironment differences. Ultimately, we verified the gene expression patterns of candidate markers through the MCAO model. We pinpointed seven diagnostic DE-PRGs, with CASP1, PIK3R5, AVEN, and PSMC3 showing significant protein expression differences. Single-cell transcriptome analysis revealed the link between stroke and immune cells. Furthermore, consensus clustering revealed two clusters with unique immune infiltration patterns and functional characteristics. Our study may provide new theoretical insights for the early diagnosis and targeted therapy of IS and offer support for the clinical application of PANoptosis in IS.
abstract_zh: 缺血性卒中（Ischemic stroke, IS）是一种引起脑功能障碍的急性神经系统疾病，具有高死亡率和高致残率。PANoptosis是一种同步化的调节性细胞死亡方式，结合了焦亡、凋亡和坏死性凋亡的特征。然而，其在缺血性卒中中的作用仍不清楚。我们从基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）数据库下载了缺血性卒中相关的微阵列数据集GSE58294，并鉴定了差异表达的PANoptosis相关基因（DE-PRGs）。我们利用三种算法识别诊断性DE-PRGs，构建了用于诊断建模的列线图，并通过受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）分析评估其诊断性能。此外，我们构建了连接基因与miRNA、转录因子和药物的相互作用网络。我们还使用GSE174574单细胞数据集分析了不同细胞亚群中的基因表达。我们应用共识聚类将卒中样本分为亚型，并比较了免疫微环境差异。最终，我们通过MCAO模型验证了候选标志物的基因表达模式。我们确定了七个诊断性DE-PRGs，其中CASP1、PIK3R5、AVEN和PSMC3显示出显著的蛋白表达差异。单细胞转录组分析揭示了卒中与免疫细胞之间的联系。此外，共识聚类揭示了两个具有独特免疫浸润模式和功能特征的聚类。我们的研究可能为IS的早期诊断和靶向治疗提供新的理论见解，并为PANoptosis在IS中的临床应用提供支持。
